column1: # MapDefinition batch: owner <TAB> M <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Template arrays are named from their call sites in World.create(): i/j are the CaptureTheFlag
# and Survival start layouts, h assigns every painted unit to the player, k only re-owns the
# producer, and l/m are the rare (random(28|12|5)==0) and common decorative props.
# a(World,IIZZCC*) are the map-char painters (terrain char -> Site, unit char -> spawned Unit).
# g() stays blank on purpose: the subclasses only return an array length and nothing in the
# tree calls it, so its meaning cannot be established.
